To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the plasma levels of TRX1 and of MIF are significantly elevated in patients suffering from severe sepsis/septic shock and that these two redox active substances show a strong correlation.
the plasma levels of Mif and Trx1 are significantly increased in patients with severe Sepsis and Septic Shock and that MIF and TRx1 show a strong correlation.
redox active substances (i.e., Thioredoxine-1, Macropage Migration Inhibitor Factor) seem to play a central role in the septic process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a better understanding of the redox balance in patients with severe infections.
the question whether there is a correlation between redox active substances and the inflammatory response in severe sepsis.
the redox status in septic patients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the redox homeostatic mechanisms are not impaired, but rather the redox homeostat has to be shifted to a more pro-oxidative/proinflammatory direction to fight the infection.
the redox homeostatic system is disturbed in patients with severe disease and that this disturbance is a key event in the pathophysiological process of sepsis.
TRX1 and IL-6 are the main mediators of sepsis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TRX1 and/or MIF could be a useful biomarker for sepsis diagnosis and/or prognosis.
the redox balance is a central part in the inflammatory process of sepsis.

the proinflammatory/oxidative and the anti-inflammatory/antioxidative responses are closely interrelated in order to maintain the redox homeostatic balance and to avoid the detrimental effects of an excessive pro- and antioxidative response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of TRX1 and/or MIF may be a useful biomarker for the diagnosis of sepsis and/or the monitoring of its progression.
redox active substances (TRX1, MIF) show a high correlation to maintain the redox homeostasisis and to avoid the detrimental effects of an excessive proinflammatory/oxidative response.
TRX1 and IL-6 are the most reliable biomarkers of the severity of sepsis.
